first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A large dark firearm that remains visible in the lower center of the image, with its central gun body extending forward and thick curved tubes on both sides.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: A dark, broken rocky surface extending from the foreground to the background, with discontinuous patches of white snow scattered across it.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: A large dark blue-gray background above the ground surface, interspersed with gray mist of varying lightness and darkness.

entities.name: Explosion and Smoke-Dust
entities.identification: A set of events consisting of firelight, radial sparks, scattered debris, and subsequent black-gray smoke clouds that repeatedly appear on the central battlefield.

entities.name: Red-Glowing Mechanical Group
entities.identification: A group of dark mechanical humanoid figures distributed in the image-left and central midground, with bright red glowing points on their bodies.
